"(e) The annuity of a retired Foreign Service officer shall
be equal to 2 per centum of his average annual basic salary
for the ten years next preceding the date of retirement, mul-
tiplied by the number of years of service not exceeding thirty
years and in determining the aggregate period of service upon
which the annuity is to be based, the fractional part of a month,

at the time of his retirement a Foreign Service officer, if the
husband of a wife to whom he has been married for at least
five years, may elect to receive a reduced annuity and designate
his wife as his beneficiary, to whom will be paid any portion
up to two-thirds of his reduced annuity, at the option of
the officer, as long as she may live after his death: Provided,
Annuity payable to
widow, limitation.
however, That the annuity payable to the widow shall in no
case exceed 25 per centum of the officer's average annual basic
salary for the ten years next preceding the date of retirement.
Computation   of
amounts.
If the age of the officer is less than the age of the wife or exceeds
her age by not more than eight years, the annuity of the officer
will be reduced by an amount equal to one-half the annuity
which he elects to have paid to his widow.  If the age of the
officer exceeds the age of the wife by more than eight years,
the annuity of the officer will be reduced by an amount equal
to one-half the annuity which he elects to have paid to his
widow plus an additional reduction equal to 2 per centum of
such widow's annuity for each year, or fraction thereof, that
